title: Parcel Sequence
play: Watch numbered parcels arrive, then select them in their original order.
skill: Sequential recall and waiting until information finishes arriving.
prog: Add parcels or insert a delay; score correct sequence length.
code: Generate an array of parcel IDs, animate presentation, then compare the response array with the answer.

title: Reverse Radio
play: Hear a sequence of digits and enter it backwards.
skill: Holding information while mentally rearranging it.
prog: Increase sequence length; measure exact accuracy and longest completed span.
code: Play prerecorded digits or generated speech; reverse the original array for evaluation. Provide a separate visual mode.

title: Window Watch
play: Several windows illuminate briefly; select their locations after the lights disappear.
skill: Visual location memory and deliberate observation.
prog: Increase grid size, illuminated windows, or recall delay.
code: Sample unique grid coordinates, hide them after presentation, and compare selected and target coordinate sets.

title: Café Orders
play: Remember several customers’ drinks and deliver each to the correct person.
prog: Add customers, modifiers, and similar orders; score complete deliveries.
code: Store customer–order mappings and validate item assignments. Use selectable buttons as an alternative to dragging.

title: Last Three
play: Symbols arrive continuously. When the stream stops, report the final three.
skill: Updating memory and discarding information that is no longer relevant.
prog: Increase the retained count or stream variability.
code: Maintain a fixed-length queue and compare it with the player’s ordered response.

title: Colour Ledger
play: Track the most recent object placed in each labelled colour category.
prog: Add categories or more frequent updates; score correct final assignments.
code: Maintain a map from category ID to latest object ID. Pair colours with text or symbols.

title: Running Balance
play: Start with ten tokens, mentally apply additions and removals, then report the balance.
prog: Add operations or enlarge quantities; score final accuracy.
code: Generate an operation list and calculate the answer using an integer reducer.

title: Shape–Sound Pairs
play: Learn which sound belongs to each shape, then choose the matching partner.
prog: Add pairs or similar sounds; track accuracy by pair.
code: Store a bijective shape–audio mapping and generate balanced distractors. Offer an independently scored visual alternative.

title: Pocket Inventory
play: Study a backpack’s contents, then identify what disappeared, appeared, or changed.
prog: Increase inventory size and number of changes.
code: Create an initial item set, apply logged mutations, and evaluate answers against the mutation list.

title: Number–Letter Mixer
play: See a mixed sequence such as B–3–A–1; return numbers ascending, then letters alphabetically.
prog: Add items; score ordering accuracy before speed.
code: Partition generated tokens by type, sort each partition, and concatenate the expected answer.

title: Moving Shelves
play: Remember objects on shelves while the shelves swap positions; find a requested object.
prog: Add swaps or shelves; measure identification accuracy.
code: Maintain stable shelf IDs and update their screen positions through a permutation model.

title: Echo Grid
play: Watch a path flash across a grid and reproduce the same route.
prog: Lengthen the route or introduce revisits.
code: Generate a coordinate sequence, play its highlights, and compare ordered selections. Distinguish it from static location recall.

title: Two-Back Orchard
play: Mark whether the current fruit matches the fruit shown two turns earlier.
skill: Continuous memory updating and resisting recent distractors.
prog: Adjust the comparison lag and presentation interval.
code: Keep stimulus history and label each eligible trial using history[t] === history[t - n].

title: Message Relay
play: Read a short message, complete a brief distraction task, then answer factual questions about it.
prog: Add message details or lengthen the interruption.
code: Use authored message–question–answer records; score factual recall without requiring identical wording.

title: Pattern Extension
play: Remember a growing sequence; each round adds one new symbol.
prog: Add symbols and later change presentation tempo.
code: Append one generated token to the sequence after each successful reproduction.

title: Seat Planner
play: Study a seating chart, then place each named guest back into the correct seat.
prog: Add guests and similar names; score exact placements.
code: Generate a guest-to-seat map and compare the reconstructed layout with the original.

title: Memory Arithmetic
play: Remember a small grid of numbers, hide it, then answer questions about selected cells.
prog: Increase grid size or question complexity.
code: Store the hidden matrix and generate questions from explicit cell references and arithmetic operators.

title: Interrupted Sequence
play: Memorise a sequence, make one unrelated judgement, then continue reproducing the sequence.
prog: Vary interruption timing and sequence length.
code: Preserve the current response index in the game state; evaluate interruption and recall performance separately.

title: Direction Stack
play: Read instructions such as north, east, south; report the final position without moving a marker.
prog: Add directions, distances, and starting locations.
code: Reduce direction vectors into a final coordinate and compare the selected destination.

title: Feature Binding
play: Remember combinations of shape, pattern, and location; identify whether a later combination appeared.
prog: Add objects and recombined distractors.
code: Represent objects as tuples and generate lures that reuse individual features in previously unseen combinations.

title: Name Garden
play: Learn fictional characters’ names and recall them after intervening rounds.
prog: Add names and extend retrieval intervals.
code: Store character–name pairs and schedule later questions using a per-item review queue.

title: Object–Place Museum
play: Place unusual objects in museum rooms, then identify where each belongs.
prog: Expand the museum and delay recall.
code: Model rooms as nodes and store object-to-room assignments with item-level recall history.

title: Story Anchors
play: Read a short story and later reconstruct its key events.
skill: Event recall and organising information into a narrative.
prog: Add events or increase the delay.
code: Use authored event arrays, distractor cards, and order constraints to evaluate reconstructions.

title: Vocabulary Voyage
play: Learn unfamiliar words through examples, then retrieve their meanings in new sentences.
prog: Move from recognition to typed recall.
code: Use curated entries with definitions, examples, accepted answers, and spaced review dates.

title: Symbol Dictionary
play: Learn the meanings of invented symbols and interpret short symbol messages.
prog: Add symbols and longer messages.
code: Generate a session dictionary and evaluate decoded messages against that mapping.

title: Landmark Return
play: Explore a small map, leave it, then return to previously visited landmarks.
prog: Add branching routes and longer gaps.
code: Store a map graph, visited landmarks, and destination answers; distinguish recall from route efficiency.

title: Pair Builder
play: Learn arbitrary object pairs, then supply the missing partner.
prog: Increase pair count and distractor similarity.
code: Maintain pair records and generate both recognition and recall trials from the same dataset.

title: Recipe Recall
play: Learn a fictional recipe, then reconstruct ingredients and preparation order.
prog: Add ingredients, quantities, and steps.
code: Store ingredient sets and ordered action lists; score omissions, additions, and ordering separately.

title: Yesterday’s Board
play: Revisit yesterday’s object board and identify which items were present.
prog: Increase item count and distractor resemblance.
code: Persist board seeds and presentation timestamps; never substitute same-session results for next-day recall.

title: Fact Ladder
play: Learn a small factual topic, retrieve key facts, then apply them to a new question.
prog: Increase the number of connected facts.
code: Use sourced content packs with prerequisite relationships and separately scored recall and application questions.

title: Sound Signature
play: Associate fictional machines with sound patterns, then identify the machines later.
prog: Add machines or make patterns more similar.
code: Store audio-pattern IDs and machine mappings; preload sounds and record playback completion.

title: Face–Detail Match
play: Learn a fictional character’s name and hobby, then recall the correct combination.
prog: Add characters and overlapping hobbies.
code: Use licensed or original portraits and structured profiles; avoid inferring personality from appearance.

title: Category Hooks
play: Organise items into categories before recalling them without the category labels.
skill: Deliberate organisation as a memory strategy.
prog: Add items and less obvious groupings.
code: Record grouping choices and later recall; compare performance without presenting strategy effects as guaranteed.

title: Forgotten Item Rescue
play: Retry previously missed items after a suitable gap.
prog: Increase delay after successful recall.
code: Maintain item-level error history and a scheduler that prioritises overdue, repeatedly missed items.

title: Timeline Traveller
play: Learn events in a fictional world and later place them in chronological order.
prog: Add events and closer dates.
code: Generate canonical event timestamps and score pairwise ordering or exact positions.

title: Rule Recall
play: Learn the rules of an imaginary sport, then apply them after playing another game.
prog: Add exceptions and scenario complexity.
code: Represent rules as explicit predicates and generate scenarios with known outcomes.

title: Password Palace
play: Remember made-up access codes associated with fictional rooms.
skill: Associating arbitrary sequences with contextual cues.
prog: Lengthen codes and increase room count.
code: Generate synthetic codes only; never request, import, or store the player’s real passwords.

title: Detail Detective
play: Study a scene and answer delayed questions about specific details.
prog: Add relevant objects and longer delays.
code: Construct scenes from structured object metadata so every question has a defensible answer.

title: Learn–Teach Cards
play: Learn a concept and arrange explanation cards to teach it back.
prog: Add distractors and prerequisite steps.
code: Evaluate required concepts and ordering constraints; allow multiple valid explanations where appropriate.

title: Memory Confidence
play: Answer a recall question and predict how likely the answer is correct.
prog: Vary delay and similarity; report accuracy alongside confidence calibration.
code: Save confidence before feedback and compare confidence bins with actual correctness over many trials.

title: Target Harbour
play: Select boats matching a target symbol while ignoring other boats.
prog: Add distractors or increase their similarity.
code: Spawn labelled entities and record hits, misses, and false selections separately.

title: Central Arrow
play: Report the direction of the central arrow while surrounding arrows point elsewhere.
prog: Vary surrounding-arrow conflict and response windows.
code: Generate congruent and incongruent trials with balanced correct directions.

title: Quiet Signal
play: Monitor a slow stream and respond only to a rare target.
prog: Extend blocks or vary target frequency.
code: Pre-generate target schedules with spacing constraints; measure omissions and false alarms, not just reaction speed.

title: Changing Shopfront
play: Compare alternating street scenes and identify the changed feature.
prog: Add objects or subtler changes.
code: Render two scene states separated by a blank interval; use logged property changes as the answer.

title: Multiple-Object Tracker
play: Memorise several marked moving objects and identify them after their markings disappear.
prog: Add targets or increase movement complexity.
code: Maintain stable object IDs, bounded motion, collision handling, and a target-ID set.

title: Pattern Search
play: Find a specific pattern among visually similar tiles.
skill: Feature search and checking before responding.
prog: Increase tile count and similarity.
code: Generate one valid target and controlled distractors; validate target uniqueness.

title: Sound Sentinel
play: Listen to a sequence of sounds and respond only to a designated pattern.
prog: Add similar distractors and longer gaps.
code: Schedule audio through Web Audio and evaluate responses relative to actual scheduled onset times.

title: Dual Watch
play: Monitor two gauges and respond when either crosses its own marked threshold.
prog: Add independent events; score each gauge separately.
code: Simulate two time series with logged crossing events and separate response windows.

title: Relevant Detail
play: Answer a specific question about a busy scene while ignoring irrelevant objects.
prog: Add irrelevant detail without changing the requested information.
code: Generate questions from scene metadata and track selection errors by distractor type.

title: Odd Rhythm
play: Identify the beat where a repeating rhythm changes.
prog: Use longer patterns or smaller timing differences.
code: Schedule beat arrays and introduce one controlled mutation. Include device calibration before timed scoring.

title: Peripheral Locator
play: Keep a central task active, then report where a brief outer symbol appeared.
prog: Adjust distance, exposure, and central-task complexity.
code: Render central and peripheral events independently. Without eye tracking, do not claim to measure fixation.

title: Proofreader’s Desk
play: Find specific typographical errors in short passages.
skill: Careful checking against a defined rule.
prog: Increase passage length and error subtlety.
code: Inject known errors into clean text and retain character-level answer offsets.

title: Feature Intersection
play: Find the object matching both a requested shape and a requested pattern.
prog: Add objects that match only one feature.
code: Generate feature tuples and guarantee exactly one intersection target.

title: Signal Queue
play: Watch two brief signals in a stream, then report both in order.
prog: Vary spacing and distractor density.
code: Generate timestamped stimulus sequences and score first-target and second-target identification separately.

title: Search Without Repeating
play: Search containers for a hidden item while avoiding containers already checked.
skill: Systematic search and monitoring previous actions.
prog: Add containers; allow an optional visible marking strategy.
code: Track opened container IDs and score redundant checks separately from successful discovery.

title: Conversation Filter
play: Follow one labelled speaker’s message while ignoring interleaved messages from others.
skill: Attending to a selected information source.
prog: Add speakers and similar content.
code: Interleave authored message streams and ask questions based only on the designated speaker.

title: Target Count
play: Count occurrences of a specified symbol in a briefly displayed board.
prog: Add distractors or increase board size.
code: Generate a board with a known target count; score absolute counting error.

title: Alert or Routine
play: Inspect fictional system messages and flag only those meeting an explicit alert rule.
skill: Distinguishing relevant events from routine information.
prog: Add near-miss messages.
code: Evaluate message attributes with a deterministic rule engine; separately track missed alerts and unnecessary alerts.

title: Moving Reading Window
play: Read a passage revealed in small sections, then answer comprehension questions.
skill: Maintaining attention across successive text segments.
prog: Adjust segment size and optional pacing.
code: Reveal authored text chunks in sequence; score comprehension rather than equating faster reading with better performance.

title: Focus Recovery
play: Complete a sorting task, handle a brief interruption, then resume where you stopped.
prog: Vary interruption timing and task complexity.
code: Save task position before interruption; measure resumption errors and time separately.

title: Go–Hold Garden
play: Pick ordinary fruit but withhold responses to marked fruit.
prog: Vary the proportion of hold trials and presentation speed.
code: Label each trial go or no-go; record correct responses, omissions, and commission errors.

title: Stop the Delivery
play: Begin selecting a destination, but cancel when a stop signal appears.
prog: Adjust stop-signal delay.
code: Schedule stop trials and log stop timing precisely; treat browser results as game measures, not clinical assessments.

title: Ink Interpreter
play: Identify a word’s ink colour while ignoring the colour named by the word.
prog: Add incompatible trials and response choices.
code: Generate word–ink pairs and score the ink attribute. Offer a separate non-colour conflict task.

title: Rule Switch Station
play: Sort objects by shape until a cue changes the rule to size.
prog: Increase switch frequency.
code: Store the active rule and label each trial as repeat or switch for separate scoring.

title: Opposite Compass
play: Select the direction opposite to the displayed arrow.
skill: Applying a rule against an automatic response.
prog: Add a clear cue that alternates between same and opposite.
code: Map directions to vectors and use vector negation for opposite answers.

title: Day–Night Signals
play: Respond “night” to a sun and “day” to a moon under the displayed rule.
prog: Introduce occasional rule changes.
code: Evaluate symbol–response mappings from an explicit rule table rather than hard-coded button positions.

title: Category Flip
play: Classify the same object by different properties across rounds.
skill: Viewing one item through multiple categories.
prog: Move from two properties to three.
code: Use objects with authored categorical attributes and a per-trial property cue.

title: Traffic Exception
play: Follow a routing rule except when a clearly marked exception applies.
prog: Add nested but understandable conditions.
code: Implement ordered predicates and test exception precedence. Use fictional traffic rules rather than teaching real driving behaviour.

title: Reverse Sort
play: Sort ascending until a cue requires descending order.
prog: Add longer lists and more switches.
code: Generate numeric arrays and derive expected order from the current direction flag.

title: Keep or Discard
play: Retain cards meeting the current rule while discarding tempting near-matches.
prog: Add compound conditions.
code: Define card predicates and generate examples that isolate individual rule violations.

title: Mirror Controls
play: Move a token through a maze while an announced mode reverses left and right controls.
prog: Increase maze complexity before adding switches.
code: Apply a control-transform function before movement; provide a persistent mode indicator.

title: Question Switch
play: Alternate between “Is it living?” and “Is it larger than a chair?”
prog: Increase rule-switch frequency and item variety.
code: Use curated items with unambiguous attributes; exclude objects whose classification depends on context.

title: Forbidden Number
play: Count upward, replacing multiples of a specified number with a symbol.
skill: Monitoring an ongoing sequence while applying exceptions.
prog: Add a second replacement rule.
code: Use modulo predicates and define how overlapping rules resolve.

title: Change the Sorting Law
play: Infer a hidden sorting rule from feedback, then notice when it changes.
skill: Revising a strategy when evidence changes.
prog: Increase possible rules and reduce redundant examples.
code: Maintain hidden rule states and ensure feedback sequences permit reasonable inference.

title: Relevant Dimension
play: Judge either an object’s displayed size or the quantity it represents, depending on a cue.
prog: Add conflicting size–quantity pairings.
code: Generate independent visual-size and numeric-value attributes; evaluate only the cued attribute.

title: Pause Before Choice
play: Wait for all clues before selecting an answer; early choices remain provisional.
prog: Add clues that overturn first impressions.
code: Stage clue releases and log provisional versus final choices; reward evidence use rather than waiting alone.

title: Exception Collector
play: Collect items from one category unless a badge overrides the category rule.
prog: Increase exception frequency and visual similarity.
code: Generate category and badge attributes independently; evaluate a documented Boolean expression.

title: Mixed-Operation Relay
play: Apply addition or subtraction according to each card’s symbol.
prog: Add multiplication and longer chains.
code: Dispatch operations from symbol IDs and generate values that avoid unintended ambiguity or excessive arithmetic.

title: Strategy Reset
play: Solve several puzzles with one method, then encounter a puzzle requiring a different method.
skill: Recognising when a habitual approach stops working.
prog: Increase superficial similarity between puzzle types.
code: Use authored puzzle families with validated solutions and record repeated ineffective actions.

title: Undo the Habit
play: Learn a response mapping, then practise a clearly announced replacement mapping.
prog: Add mappings or lengthen the initial learning phase.
code: Keep old and new answer tables; classify errors that specifically repeat the previous mapping.

title: Symbol Twins
play: Decide whether two symbol strings are identical.
prog: Lengthen strings and make differences subtler.
code: Generate matching pairs or mutate one indexed symbol; score accuracy and correct-response time separately.

title: Code Key
play: Use a visible key to translate symbols into numbers.
prog: Add key entries; optionally hide the key in a separately scored mode.
code: Generate a mapping table and translation queue; distinguish lookup trials from memory trials.

title: Bigger Value
play: Select the larger of two numbers.
prog: Add decimals, negatives, and closer values.
code: Generate numeric pairs with controlled distance and render consistent notation.

title: Rapid Category
play: Classify items into two clearly defined categories.
prog: Add more similar examples.
code: Draw from a curated labelled dataset and balance categories to prevent response guessing.

title: Matching Stream
play: Compare each new card with a permanently visible reference.
skill: Rapid comparison without a memory requirement.
prog: Increase feature complexity.
code: Keep the reference visible and generate trials with controlled matching and nonmatching proportions.

title: Letter Locator
play: Find a named letter in a small grid.
prog: Add letters and similar distractors.
code: Generate a grid with one target and assign keyboard-accessible cell controls.

title: Quantity Glance
play: Briefly view a small dot group and report its quantity.
prog: Adjust exposure and spatial arrangement.
code: Generate non-overlapping dots with known count; keep larger estimation tasks separately scored.

title: Same Meaning
play: Match a written number with its equivalent dot group or numeral.
prog: Add larger quantities and closer distractors.
code: Generate all answer representations from one canonical numeric value.

title: Pattern Passport
play: Decide whether a tile matches a visible pattern template.
prog: Add rotations and small differences.
code: Compare structured tile matrices; explicitly specify whether rotation counts as a match.

title: Route Flash
play: Select which of two visible routes has fewer steps.
prog: Use closer route lengths.
code: Generate grid paths, calculate step counts, and ensure visual styling does not reveal the answer accidentally.

title: Word–Picture Match
play: Decide whether a displayed word names the pictured object.
prog: Use closer semantic distractors.
code: Use curated word–image records with accepted regional vocabulary and language-specific labels.

title: Missing Piece Sprint
play: Choose the piece that completes a simple visual pattern.
prog: Add answer options and pattern complexity.
code: Remove a known component and generate distractors by controlled geometric mutations.

title: Order Check
play: Decide whether a sequence is correctly sorted.
prog: Increase length and use nearby swaps.
code: Generate sorted arrays and inject logged inversions; evaluate using the selected comparison rule.

title: One Different
play: Find the sole object that differs from the rest.
prog: Increase item count and reduce feature contrast.
code: Generate a shared base object and mutate exactly one feature on one item.

title: Rapid Equation Check
play: Mark simple equations correct or incorrect.
prog: Increase operand size and plausible error types.
code: Generate equations from exact arithmetic and construct false results using controlled offsets.

title: Sound Pair Check
play: Decide whether two short sound patterns match.
prog: Lengthen patterns and use smaller differences.
code: Generate tone sequences and mutate pitch, order, or duration; score each difference type independently.

title: Orientation Check
play: Decide whether two arrows face the same direction.
prog: Add more possible angles.
code: Store canonical angles and compare them modulo a full rotation.

title: Fraction Flash
play: Match a shaded shape to the correct fraction.
prog: Introduce equivalent fractions and varied shapes.
code: Generate numerator–denominator pairs and render equal-area partitions; avoid unequal segments.

title: Duplicate Detector
play: Identify the repeated item in a visible list.
prog: Lengthen the list and increase similarity.
code: Sample unique tokens, duplicate one, and shuffle; validate that no accidental second duplicate exists.

title: Accuracy Pacekeeper
play: Complete comparison tasks at a self-selected pace, then adjust pace while preserving accuracy.
prog: Change complexity rather than imposing an arbitrary faster target.
code: Calculate block accuracy and median correct-response time; display the trade-off without collapsing it into one score.

title: Rule Detective
play: Infer the rule separating accepted and rejected objects.
prog: Add rule dimensions and exceptions.
code: Generate examples from a hidden predicate; let players request informative test cases.

title: Mini Logic Houses
play: Assign people, pets, and objects to houses using clues.
prog: Add houses and clue relationships.
code: Generate a complete solution, derive clues, and use a solver to check uniqueness.

title: Circuit Path
play: Rotate connectors to link a power source to a target.
prog: Add branches and blocked tiles.
code: Represent connectors as graph edges and test source-to-target reachability after each rotation.

title: Balance Mystery
play: Use a limited number of balance-scale comparisons to find an unusual object.
prog: Add objects and vary whether the odd object is heavier or lighter.
code: Maintain candidate hypotheses and simulate scale outcomes from hidden weights.

title: Sequence Laboratory
play: Identify the next item in a rule-based sequence.
prog: Introduce alternating and interleaved rules.
code: Generate sequences from explicit rule families; reject questions with multiple plausible answers among the choices.

title: Truthful Robots
play: Determine which fictional robots make consistent true or false statements.
prog: Add linked statements.
code: Encode statements as Boolean expressions and enumerate assignments; accept only puzzles with a unique intended solution.

title: Constraint Garden
play: Place plants so every row and neighbour rule is satisfied.
prog: Add plant types and restrictions.
code: Use a backtracking solver to generate and validate boards; show exactly which constraints are violated.

title: Cause-and-Effect Machine
play: Operate switches to discover which ones control different outputs.
prog: Add interacting switches.
code: Use a hidden Boolean circuit and log experiments; reward identifying a consistent model.

title: Minimal Clue
play: Solve a mystery while choosing which additional clues to reveal.
prog: Add candidates and less informative clues.
code: Maintain a candidate set and calculate how each clue partitions it; score solution accuracy and clue cost.

title: Counterexample Hunt
play: Find the example that disproves a proposed rule.
skill: Testing claims instead of only confirming them.
prog: Use more subtle counterexamples.
code: Evaluate all options against a formal rule and ensure exactly one violates the claim.

title: Number Lock
play: Infer a hidden numeric code from positional feedback.
prog: Increase code length and symbol choices.
code: Calculate exact-position and wrong-position matches with duplicate-aware counting.

title: Bridge Limits
play: Route fictional vehicles across bridges with specified capacities.
prog: Add bridges, dependencies, and competing routes.
code: Model a capacity-constrained graph and validate every crossing against explicit rules.

title: Tile Equation
play: Arrange number and operator tiles to produce a target.
prog: Add operations and placement constraints.
code: Evaluate expression trees with defined precedence; use exact fractions where division is allowed.

title: Hidden Transformation
play: Infer how a machine transforms shapes from input–output examples.
prog: Compose transformations such as rotation and feature replacement.
code: Implement transformation functions and generate candidate rules that examples can distinguish.

title: Necessary or Sufficient
play: Classify statements about a fictional system as necessary, sufficient, both, or neither.
prog: Add chained conditions.
code: Generate truth tables and derive correct classifications from them.

title: Puzzle Repair
play: Change one clue or tile to make an inconsistent puzzle solvable.
prog: Increase puzzle size and repair choices.
code: Introduce one controlled inconsistency into a valid puzzle and verify allowed repairs with a solver.

title: Set Builder
play: Select objects satisfying a combination of inclusion and exclusion rules.
prog: Add intersections and complements.
code: Represent object attributes as sets or bitmasks and evaluate the displayed set expression.

title: Invariant Hunt
play: Discover what remains unchanged while a board undergoes legal moves.
prog: Introduce less obvious invariants.
code: Generate transformations preserving a chosen property, such as parity, and test candidate explanations.

title: Analogy Workshop
play: Complete relationships such as “rotation is to orientation as resizing is to …”
prog: Move from concrete to abstract relations.
code: Use authored relation templates and distractors representing specific relation errors.

title: Proof Path
play: Arrange reasoning steps into a valid explanation.
prog: Add irrelevant or invalid steps.
code: Represent prerequisites as a directed graph and validate whether the selected order supports the conclusion.

title: Delivery Planner
play: Plan a route visiting every delivery point within a distance budget.
prog: Add locations and delivery constraints.
code: Use a weighted graph and calculate feasible routes; compare with the optimal route for small boards.

title: Calendar Tetris
play: Fit fictional appointments into a day without conflicts.
prog: Add travel time, deadlines, and fixed appointments.
code: Use interval arithmetic and explicit availability windows; validate overlaps and travel gaps.

title: Kitchen Conductor
play: Start fictional cooking steps so all dishes finish together.
prog: Add shared equipment and more dishes.
code: Model recipes as task graphs with resource locks and a simulated clock.

title: Limited Moves
play: Solve a board puzzle within a fixed number of actions.
prog: Increase search depth.
code: Generate states from known solutions and use breadth-first search to verify the minimum move count.

title: Priority Desk
play: Order tasks using displayed deadlines, values, and dependencies.
prog: Introduce competing constraints.
code: Define the objective mathematically and score against it; avoid pretending one task order is universally best.

title: Warehouse Stack
play: Arrange containers so needed items can be retrieved with few unnecessary moves.
prog: Add containers and retrieval stages.
code: Represent stacks as arrays and simulate the full retrieval sequence.

title: Battery Expedition
play: Reach landmarks while managing a fictional robot’s charge.
prog: Add recharge points and uncertain costs in clearly labelled modes.
code: Use graph search over position-and-energy states; reject generated maps without a feasible route.

title: Dependency Builder
play: Complete a project by arranging prerequisite tasks correctly.
prog: Add parallel tasks and shared resources.
code: Generate acyclic task graphs and validate topological order.

title: Travel Buffer
play: Schedule a journey using travel times and explicitly stated delay possibilities.
prog: Add connections and varied delay distributions.
code: Simulate outcomes from displayed distributions and compare punctuality across plans.

title: Packing Constraints
play: Pack required objects into a limited container.
prog: Add irregular shapes and weight limits.
code: Use grid occupancy masks and a solver to check that required objects can fit.

title: Rescue Sequence
play: Move fictional stranded characters to safety while respecting capacity rules.
prog: Add transport and ordering constraints.
code: Model valid states and transitions; search for solutions and flag illegal moves immediately.

title: Maintenance Window
play: Schedule machine maintenance while keeping enough fictional production active.
prog: Add dependencies and time windows.
code: Simulate machine availability and evaluate output against explicit thresholds.

title: Goal Decomposer
play: Break a fictional goal into actionable steps and order them.
skill: Turning a broad objective into a plan.
prog: Add missing prerequisites and unnecessary steps.
code: Use authored goal templates and prerequisite graphs; explain why selected steps are required.

title: Replanning Storm
play: Adapt an existing route after a road closes.
skill: Revising a plan after new information.
prog: Add closures and time constraints.
code: Modify graph edges during the round and recompute feasible paths from the current position.

title: Budget Builder
play: Allocate fictional tokens across projects to meet stated goals.
prog: Add dependencies and minimum commitments.
code: Use integer allocation models and explicit utility tables; show several valid trade-offs when appropriate.

title: Queue Manager
play: Process fictional jobs to minimise waiting under a specified scoring rule.
prog: Add arrival times and different job lengths.
code: Use a discrete-event simulator and compare completion schedules against the announced objective.

title: Checkpoint Planner
play: Choose where to save progress during a simulated expedition with restart risks.
prog: Vary checkpoint cost and failure probability.
code: Simulate reproducible outcome sequences and compare strategies across many runs.

title: Tool Before Task
play: Gather the necessary tools before attempting each fictional repair.
prog: Add shared tools and carrying limits.
code: Define required-tool sets and validate inventory before permitting task completion.

title: Time Estimate Lab
play: Estimate how long a puzzle will take, complete it, then compare estimate and outcome.
prog: Introduce unfamiliar puzzle types.
code: Save estimates before starting and calculate signed and absolute estimation error.

title: Plan–Do–Review
play: Write or select a plan, execute it in a simulation, and choose a revision afterward.
prog: Add longer scenarios and changing conditions.
code: Store planned actions and executed events separately; generate feedback from the differences.

title: Rotation Match
play: Choose which object is a rotated version of a target.
prog: Increase angular difference and shape complexity.
code: Generate vector shapes and rotate coordinates; create mirrored distractors separately.

title: Folded Paper
play: Predict where holes appear after a folded sheet is unfolded.
prog: Add folds and hole positions.
code: Apply reflection transforms to punched coordinates in reverse fold order.

title: Cube Net
play: Select which flat net folds into a displayed cube.
prog: Add face markings and rotations.
code: Map net faces to cube orientations and validate adjacency and opposing faces.

title: Perspective Finder
play: Identify how a block arrangement looks from another direction.
prog: Add blocks and occlusion.
code: Store a three-dimensional occupancy grid and render orthographic views from selected directions.

title: Mirror Maze
play: Predict a light beam’s path through mirrors.
prog: Add mirrors and branches.
code: Trace rays through a grid using reflection rules; detect loops and validate the exit.

title: Shape Assembly
play: Combine pieces into a target silhouette.
prog: Add pieces and allow rotation.
code: Use polygon or grid masks to test coverage, overlaps, and boundary violations.

title: Hidden Blocks
play: Infer the number of cubes in a stack using visible views and stated construction rules.
prog: Add layers and viewpoints.
code: Generate voxel models and ensure the supplied views uniquely determine the requested answer.

title: Map Rotation
play: Use a rotated map to select the correct travel direction.
skill: Switching between map and viewer orientation.
prog: Add arbitrary rotation angles.
code: Transform world coordinates into screen coordinates with a rotation matrix.

title: Path Integration
play: Watch movements away from a starting point, then indicate the direction back.
prog: Add turns and variable distances.
code: Sum movement vectors and calculate the return vector; score angle and distance error separately.

title: Cross-Section Studio
play: Predict the shape revealed when a solid is sliced.
prog: Add oblique cuts and compound solids.
code: Begin with authored solid–plane combinations and validated polygon cross-sections.

title: Relative Position
play: Arrange objects according to clues such as “A is behind B and left of C.”
prog: Add objects and chained clues.
code: Evaluate coordinates against relational constraints and allow multiple valid layouts when clues permit them.

title: Shadow Match
play: Match a three-dimensional object to its projected shadow.
prog: Change light direction and object orientation.
code: Project mesh vertices onto a plane and compare candidate silhouettes.

title: Route Reconstruction
play: Watch a route from a first-person view and rebuild it on a map.
prog: Add intersections and repeated landmarks.
code: Generate both views from one underlying graph and compare the reconstructed edge sequence.

title: Symmetry Workshop
play: Complete the missing half of a pattern.
prog: Add diagonal axes and multiple symmetry rules.
code: Reflect coordinates across a defined axis and compare cell or vector placements.

title: Packing Rotation
play: Rotate objects to fit them through a shaped opening.
prog: Add asymmetric shapes and tighter tolerances.
code: Transform object polygons and perform containment checks against the opening.

title: Scale Mapper
play: Reconstruct a layout at a different scale.
prog: Use non-integer scaling factors.
code: Apply a scale transform to source coordinates and score normalised position error.

title: Landmark Ordering
play: Infer the order of landmarks from several partial views.
prog: Add overlapping views and distractors.
code: Convert views into ordering constraints and solve for layouts consistent with all observations.

title: Tile Navigation
play: Navigate a token using relative commands such as forward, left, and right.
prog: Add turns and longer command sequences.
code: Maintain position plus heading; translate relative commands into world-coordinate movements.

title: Occlusion Detective
play: Identify a partially hidden shape from its visible fragments.
skill: Inferring whole forms from incomplete information.
prog: Increase occlusion while retaining distinguishable evidence.
code: Mask known shapes and reject trials where multiple options fit the visible region equally well.

title: Construction Blueprint
play: Build a block structure from top, front, and side views.
prog: Add height and footprint complexity.
code: Compare voxel projections with target views; accept alternative structures when the views do not uniquely specify one.

title: Word Ladder
play: Change one letter at a time to transform one word into another.
prog: Increase word length and shortest-path distance.
code: Build a dictionary graph linking words one letter apart; use breadth-first search to validate solutions.

title: Category Sprint
play: Produce words belonging to a category without repeats.
prog: Narrow categories or add starting-letter restrictions.
code: Validate entries against curated category lists; normalise spelling variants and track duplicates.

title: Meaning in Context
play: Choose the intended meaning of a word in a sentence.
prog: Add more ambiguous words.
code: Use authored sentences and sense-specific answer sets rather than dictionary definitions alone.

title: Sentence Repair
play: Rearrange fragments into a clear, grammatical sentence.
prog: Add clauses and distractors.
code: Store accepted arrangements or grammar constraints; allow equivalent valid constructions.

title: Concise Messenger
play: Shorten a message while retaining its essential meaning.
prog: Tighten the word budget.
code: Start with selectable phrase deletion and authored essential-fact checks; avoid unreliable unrestricted semantic grading.

title: Ambiguity Detective
play: Identify why a sentence has multiple possible meanings and choose a clearer revision.
prog: Add pronoun, scope, and modifier ambiguity.
code: Use authored ambiguity categories and validated revisions.

title: Analogy Bridge
play: Match word pairs sharing the same relationship.
prog: Introduce subtler relationships.
code: Label pairs by relation type and create distractors based on association without the required relationship.

title: Instruction Builder
play: Arrange steps so another character can complete a task.
prog: Add prerequisites and optional steps.
code: Execute the selected instruction sequence in a small deterministic simulation.

title: Main-Idea Finder
play: Choose the sentence best summarising a short passage.
skill: Distinguishing central ideas from supporting details.
prog: Lengthen passages and use plausible partial summaries.
code: Use authored passages with explanation-backed answers and distractors representing specific comprehension errors.

title: Evidence Match
play: Match a claim to the passage that actually supports it.
prog: Add related but insufficient passages.
code: Store explicit claim–evidence relationships and explain unsupported inference errors.

title: Number Line Navigator
play: Place a number on an unmarked or partly marked number line.
prog: Add negatives, decimals, and fractions.
code: Map numeric values to coordinates and score error relative to the displayed range.

title: Estimate First
play: Estimate an arithmetic answer before calculating it exactly.
prog: Add larger values and mixed operations.
code: Save the estimate separately, compute the exact result, and display relative estimation error.

title: Fraction Duel
play: Select the larger of two fractions.
prog: Use closer values and unlike denominators.
code: Compare fractions through integer cross-multiplication, avoiding floating-point rounding errors.

title: Percentage Transformer
play: Match percentages, decimals, fractions, and visual proportions.
prog: Add less familiar equivalent values.
code: Store canonical rational values and generate equivalent display formats.

title: Mental Checkout
play: Calculate fictional purchase totals and change.
prog: Add discounts and explicitly stated taxes.
code: Use integer cents and configurable fictional pricing rules; show an itemised solution afterward.

title: Ratio Kitchen
play: Scale a fictional recipe while preserving ingredient ratios.
prog: Add fractional serving changes.
code: Represent quantities as rational numbers and multiply every ingredient by the same scale factor.

title: Data Detective
play: Answer questions from a small chart or table.
prog: Add comparisons and multi-step calculations.
code: Generate charts and answers from the same data model; label units and axes explicitly.

title: Probability Marbles
play: Predict the chance of drawing a particular marble from a visible bag.
prog: Add multiple draws and replacement rules.
code: Calculate exact probabilities and simulate repeated draws to compare predictions with long-run frequencies.

title: Unit Switch
play: Convert quantities between clearly specified units.
prog: Add multi-step conversions.
code: Use a unit registry with exact conversion factors where possible and enforce compatible dimensions.

title: Patterned Arithmetic
play: Find an efficient way to calculate a result using grouping, complements, or decomposition.
prog: Introduce problems suited to different methods.
code: Provide selectable transformation steps and verify that each preserves the original expression’s value.

title: Confidence Compass
play: Answer questions and assign confidence before receiving feedback.
prog: Add unfamiliar topics and deceptive distractors.
code: Store predicted probabilities and outcomes; show calibration curves after enough trials, with clear sample sizes.

title: Evidence Updater
play: Estimate which fictional explanation is likely, then revise after new clues.
prog: Add stronger and weaker evidence.
code: Generate scenarios with explicit prior probabilities and likelihoods; calculate reference updates.

title: Base-Rate Detective
play: Judge a fictional classification problem using both prevalence and test accuracy.
prog: Vary prevalence and false-positive rates.
code: Generate population-count tables and derive answers from actual counts. Avoid medical screening scenarios.

title: Sample-Size Studio
play: Decide which of two observations provides stronger evidence about a simulated process.
prog: Add noisy and unbalanced samples.
code: Simulate draws from known distributions and display intervals or repeated-sampling demonstrations.

title: Confirmation Trap
play: Choose the next test that best distinguishes competing explanations.
prog: Add plausible but uninformative tests.
code: Maintain explicit hypotheses and rank test usefulness by expected reduction in uncertainty.

title: Sunk-Cost Expedition
play: Decide whether to continue a fictional project after costs and future prospects change.
skill: Separating past expenditure from future consequences.
prog: Add emotionally appealing story details.
code: Calculate future options from remaining costs and benefits; explain the comparison without rewarding past spending itself.

title: Framing Mirror
play: Make choices presented in equivalent gain and loss formats, then compare responses.
prog: Add more complex equivalent descriptions.
code: Generate paired scenarios from one outcome table and separate them to reduce immediate recognition.

title: Forecast Tournament
play: Predict outcomes of transparent simulated events.
prog: Add interacting variables.
code: Use seeded simulations and proper probability scoring; explain that simulation skill does not establish real-world forecasting ability.

title: Information Value
play: Decide whether buying a clue is worth its fictional token cost.
skill: Comparing information cost with decision value.
prog: Add clues with different reliability.
code: Model possible states, actions, payoffs, and clue likelihoods; calculate expected value with and without information.

title: Stop-Searching Challenge
play: Inspect options sequentially and decide when to choose.
prog: Vary the option distribution and whether earlier options remain available.
code: Implement explicit search rules and simulate benchmark strategies under those same rules.

title: If–Then Builder
play: Turn a fictional intention into a specific cue–action plan.
skill: Connecting a situation with an actionable response.
prog: Add conflicting cues and vague distractors.
code: Use structured fields for cue, action, and context; evaluate specificity using authored criteria.

title: Distraction Budget
play: Configure a simulated workspace before completing a task with optional interruptions.
prog: Add interruption types and competing priorities.
code: Simulate notification schedules and compare task outcomes across configurations while controlling task difficulty.

title: Error Detective
play: Inspect a worked solution, locate the first error, and correct it.
skill: Diagnosing mistakes rather than guessing again.
prog: Add longer reasoning chains.
code: Generate valid solution steps, inject one error, and track downstream consequences.

title: Strategy Selector
play: Choose a method before solving a puzzle, then review whether it suited the problem.
prog: Introduce several puzzle families.
code: Tag puzzles with applicable strategies and log chosen methods, hints, accuracy, and completion time.

title: Breakpoint Planner
play: Schedule pauses across a simulated workload and observe results under the displayed model.
skill: Planning rest and reviewing workload assumptions.
prog: Vary workload patterns.
code: Use a clearly labelled fictional performance model; do not present simulated outcomes as personalised health guidance.

title: Alternative Explanation
play: Generate or select multiple plausible explanations before choosing what evidence to gather.
prog: Add misleading surface details.
code: Use authored causal scenarios and score explanation distinctness and evidence relevance, not agreement with one unsupported story.

title: Perspective Switch
play: Review a fictional disagreement from each character’s stated information and goals.
prog: Add differing information access.
code: Store character knowledge and goals explicitly; evaluate answers against stated facts without inferring emotions from faces.

title: Decision Journal
play: Record a prediction and reason, observe a simulated outcome, then review the original judgement.
prog: Add noisy outcomes.
code: Save an immutable pre-outcome entry and compare expected-value reasoning with realised results.

title: Transfer Mission
play: After practising a skill, attempt a new task with different visuals, content, and response demands.
skill: Applying a strategy in another context.
prog: Increase distance from the original task.
code: Keep training and evaluation item banks separate; measure improvement on unseen tasks without assuming broad transfer.

title: Personal Experiment Lab
play: Compare two strategies—such as grouping versus repetition—across matched memory tasks.
prog: Add repeated sessions and delayed recall.
code: Randomise strategy order, counterbalance matched item sets, and report differences with sample size and uncertainty.
